name: @migor/agentia
description: 面向应用开发者的声明式 agent 服务开发框架：装饰器 + DI 声明 tool/skill/subagent/prompt 单元，主 agent 编排执行，交付可上线的 Agent 服务。

scripts.build:cli: npm run build -w @migor/trace-view && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && node packages/cli/scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.build:website: npm run build -w @migor/trace-view && npm run build -w @migor/website
scripts.deploy:website: npm run build:website && npx wrangler pages deploy packages/website/dist --project-name=agentia-web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run build:cli && tsx scripts/e2e-cli.ts
